system.description: • Effect: Damage your Illusion spells deal to a creature that believes them is real: it can drop the creature to 0 HP, and Shadow Monsters, which reduces its damage to believers, deals full damage. A creature that sees through the illusion takes none.

rules.value: Half-Real: your Illusion spells' damage to a creature that believes them is real (it can drop it to 0 HP and doesn't fade); half-damage illusions (Shadow Monsters) deal full.
